name: hx_lmtd_ua
title: Counterflow heat exchanger and condenser rated by UA and a smoothed LMTD (TESPy)
summary: Translation of the TESPy component classes HeatExchanger and its condensing subclass Condenser: a counterflow exchanger with the duty closed by a terminal temperature difference, by a duty or by the heat-transfer coefficient UA through the smoothed LMTD (Quoilin 2011), with pinch and effectiveness results, plus the off-design UA characteristic lines. Each file ships the design and the off-design run of the corresponding TESPy class doctest (air/water exchanger and air-cooled waste-steam condenser).
language_features: arrays for the diagram state points

authors: Francesco Witte (TESPy lead developer) and the TESPy contributors
Sylvain Quoilin (smoothed LMTD, PhD thesis, University of Liege, 2011)
origin.notes: TESPy commit 19425523; also src/tespy/data/char_lines.json (DEFAULT UA characteristic lines, shipped as the lookup tables). The condenser variant is the _condenser variant of the same card (TSP-009). Translation published under the CoolSolve_Library MIT licence (decision D3).

verification.summary: Compared with the TESPy HeatExchanger and Condenser class doctests re-run (design and off-design): main file 22 common variables, 0 differ at rtol=0.001, max 3.30e-07; condenser 21 common variables, 0 differ, max 4.28e-05 (M_dot_c_2), due to the air density.
verification.reference: the HeatExchanger and Condenser class doctests of TESPy re-run from the local clone (commit 19425523) in a throw-away virtual environment (pip install -e ~/git/tespy, CoolProp 8.1.0dev): design and off-design run of each, 22 + 21 compared quantities via tools/compare_solution.py
verification.notes: compare_solution.py --all: main file 22 common variables, 0 differ (rtol=0.001), max 3.30e-07 (T_h_ex_2); condenser 21 common variables, 0 differ, max 4.28e-05 (M_dot_c_2). The residual deviation is the air density: EES Air is the ideal-gas substance, TESPy uses the CoolProp air mixture (4e-05 at 30 C, 1.001 bar). Absolute enthalpies/entropies are excluded (different reference states, same offsets in numerator and denominator so duties and effectivenesses still agree).

related_external: TESPy HeatExchanger and Condenser component classes (github.com/oemof/tespy, commit 19425523)

history.action: added (T-TRANSLATE card C-182, batch B-12: TESPy TSP-008 HeatExchanger and TSP-009 Condenser)
